reason: I already have my gummies and I reorder them when they run out, I'm not looking to switch. Also I forget vitamins half the time anyway, so a new box would just sit on the counter.
objection: Thirty foil sachets a month feels like a lot of packaging waste for something I'd take in two seconds from a bottle.
would_change_my_mind: If I ran out of what I take now and a friend I trust said this one actually helped her sleep, and the packaging was recyclable.
